learnings: API errors should not result in 'inconclusive' verdicts when other models successfully complete the audit - the tool should retry failed files or defer to successful audits
When multiple models are used, the tool should aggregate results and only mark 'inconclusive' if ALL models fail to review critical files
Parsing errors (like Report 3's linux.install.pkg) should trigger automatic retry with the same model rather than marking the file inconclusive
